project: Finance ERP Upgrade - Cutover Communications Plan
cutover_type: Upgrade / change to an existing system
cadence_rule: Upgrade/change base = 5 comms (T-14, T-7, T-1, cutover begins, go-live)
modifiers: Business downtime window: +1 service restored (cutover-begins covers outage start)
User action required before cutover: +1 action-required notice at T-3
notes: Send dates assume approval lead time of 3 business days. Content links to be populated once drafts exist.

comms.title: Finance ERP upgrade: what's changing and when
comms.purpose: Give early awareness of the upgrade, the cutover weekend and what will be unavailable, so teams can plan month-end work around it.
comms.dependencies: Confirmed cutover window; distribution list validated with HR
comms.notes: Sponsor voice deliberately used for the first comms to establish legitimacy.

comms.title: One week to go: Finance ERP cutover
comms.purpose: Reinforce the cutover dates, confirm the downtime window and point users to training and support materials.
comms.audience: All Finance users; Finance line managers
comms.dependencies: Training materials published to intranet; support model confirmed

comms.title: Action required before Thursday: clear your open items
comms.purpose: Drive the specific pre-cutover user action - submit or clear all open purchase requisitions and expense claims before the freeze.
comms.audience: All Finance users; AP/AR processing teams
comms.dependencies: Freeze cut-off time confirmed in runbook; step-by-step job aid drafted
comms.notes: Modifier-driven comms. Track completion; chase non-completers via manager cascade at T-1.

comms.title: Tomorrow: Finance ERP goes offline at 18:00
comms.purpose: Final reminder of the exact downtime start, what to save or close beforehand, and where to go for support during the outage.
comms.audience: All Finance users; Service Desk; Finance line managers
comms.dependencies: Go/No-Go decision taken at T-1 09:00; Service Desk briefed
comms.notes: Hold for the Go/No-Go outcome - do not schedule to auto-send.

comms.title: Finance ERP cutover has started - system now unavailable
comms.purpose: Confirm cutover is underway, the system is offline as planned, and set expectation for the next update.
comms.audience: All Finance users; Service Desk; Executive stakeholders
comms.dependencies: Cutover runbook step 1 complete (system taken offline)

comms.title: Finance ERP is live - you can log in now
comms.purpose: Confirm the system is live and available, what users should do first, and how to get help in the hypercare period.
comms.audience: All Finance users; Finance line managers; Service Desk
comms.dependencies: Post-cutover validation complete and signed off; hypercare channel live
comms.notes: Doubles as the 'service restored' comms required by the downtime modifier.
